args.title: Improve accessibility for error toasts
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

The issue is that error messages shown as toasts use the polite live region, causing screen readers to delay before announcing them. Additionally, they disappear after five seconds, which may not be sufficient for all users, especially those who rely on assistive technologies.

To address this, toasts with kind 'error' should use an 'assertive' aria-live setting to ensure immediate announcement, and they should remain visible until explicitly dismissed by the user.
